Neither self-adjointness nor a pure-point spectral hypothesis is stated.

issues.failure_explanation: Analyticity plus integrability on only the two boundary curves does not control growth inside the unbounded domain. Set w=φ(z) and F(z)=φ′(z)^(1/2) exp(cosh(πw/d)). On w=x±id its weighted squared boundary modulus is exp(−2cosh(πx/d)), so F belongs to the defined N2 class.
